mappings.rationale: Evaluate(base+70) requires a pending planning-review occurrence whose evidence.Handoff is planningRef. Account.Coverage is one interval ValidUntil=base+100 and not Ended, and the next planning-review deadline is base+90 (reviewEvery=20) still inside coverage. After Attempt, Renew to coverage base+200 / next review base+150 with a plan digest, and Report OutcomeVerified, Evaluate(base+101) asserts zero fallback rows, pending work at nominal base+100, and the next planning-review deadline at base+150. A Renew that does not extend coverage returns ErrInvalidPlan. Limits: no crash/restart around Renew or Report, so atomic arming of period N+1 is not durability-tested; the test never evaluates at base+150. This is source-level evidence, not an observed test pass.

After Attempt of work at base and leaving the base+10 occurrence undelivered, Evaluate(base+101) requires a pending fallback at nominal base+100 with evidence.Handoff=recoveryRef, the undelivered work in state lapsed, and the delivered work still pending or acknowledged. No work with nominal>base is pending, Attempt of work at base+100 returns ErrNotPending, and Account next fallback is at base+111. Evaluate(base+111) then requires two fallback occurrences so the review cadence continues. Limits: failed planning Report is not this test; no process kill; overdue flags on the fallback deadline are not asserted. This is source-level evidence, not an observed test pass.

For stages committed and attempted, a child Opens the same ledger path, Evaluate(base), optionally Attempt, writes a durable ready file, then is SIGKILLed. Parent Evaluate(base) requires exactly one kind=work row, so kill-after-commit did not manufacture a second semantic identity. Account.Due is that work id and Unresolved equals that same id. The committed stage never calls Attempt, matching kill before publication. Limits: the parent keeps its original Store open rather than proving a cold Open-only restart; Pending() and Attempts are not asserted here; child exit codes are not checked. This is source-level evidence, not an observed test pass.

Subtest all sets MaxBatch=2 and Evaluate(base+35): exactly two pending work rows and NextEvaluation=base+20 so remaining backlog is immediately due; a second Evaluate at the same now leaves work at base, base+10, base+20, and base+30 all pending. Subtest latest (CatchUpLatest) Evaluate(base+35) requires a single work occurrence at nominal base+30 with CoveredFrom=base, CoveredCount=4, state pending. Subtest skip (CatchUpSkip) Evaluate(base+31) records the base occurrence Disposition=skipped CoveredCount=3, emits pending work at base+30 within graceSeconds=2, and Evaluate(base+45) leaves base+40 skipped. Limits: no process downtime; skip does not list every omitted nominal besides base and base+40; all does not inspect CoveredFrom. This is source-level evidence, not an observed test pass.

For OverlapAllow, OverlapDefer, and OverlapCoalesce the test Evaluate(base), Attempt and Acknowledge the first work, then Evaluate(base+10) and Attempt the second. Allow must succeed immediately. Defer and coalesce must return ErrOverlapDeferred while the first remains acknowledged but unreported. After Report of the first with OutcomeVerified and a digest, Attempt of the second succeeds. This shows policy-dependent publication gating without treating acknowledgement as completion. Limits: Attempt/Acknowledge are direct Store calls, not transport; coalesce of older undelivered work is not asserted here; no restart. This is source-level evidence, not an observed test pass.

The test Attempt then Acknowledge work, Close, and reopen the ledger. Account at base+1 requires state acknowledged and the work id in both MayHaveExecuted and Unresolved. Evaluate(base+21) creates a return-review whose evidence.Handoff is recoveryRef, and the count of state=verified remains 0. Limits: acknowledgement is Store.Acknowledge, not HTTP delivery success; the persisted next-deadline row is not read directly; OutcomeUncertain is not exercised. This is source-level evidence, not an observed test pass.

After Attempt of work at base, Pause until base+50 at now=base+1 with a reason. Evaluate(base+30) still has exactly one work occurrence and one return-review for that parent, so pause stopped work materialization without suppressing returns. Account next work deadline is base+50 and not overdue. Evaluate(base+50) requires pending work at nominal base+50. Pause with an empty reason or a non-future end returns ErrInvalidControl. Limits: planning-review during the pause window is not evaluated (next planning instant is base+70, after pause end); supersession is not this test; pause durability across process restart is not shown. This is source-level evidence, not an observed test pass.

After SIGKILL of the child at committed or attempted, parent Evaluate plus requireCovered(base+1) checks Account.Due and Unresolved are the single work id; Emitted and MayHaveExecuted contain that id only for the attempted stage. Deadlines for work (base+10), planning-review (base+70), and return:<work> (base+20) must be present with matching At and Overdue false. requireCovered asserts Uncovered is empty, so every active obligation still has a future evaluation. Limits: overdue=true is never asserted; fallback is not in the deadline map; the parent Store was already open; HTTP outbox/publication is not involved. This is source-level evidence, not an observed test pass.
